column3: NASB supplies “they” as those who carried them into exile.
NASB adds “namely” and a dash; the Hebrew is difficult.
NASB supplies “children,” and renders “sent away … his wives” as “after he had sent away Hushim and Baara his wives.”
“Chiefs of fathers” is rendered “heads of fathers’ households.”
NASB includes the name “Jeiel,” which is not in the Hebrew here but appears in 9:35.
NASB follows the Hebrew and does not have “Ner” (compare 9:36).
